info.title: Iqos Haven — implemented API contracts
info.description: Implemented health, identity, staff, settings and delivery administration contracts. Browser identity commands require the configured admin Origin and JSON bodies; responses are no-store. Identity UI is roadmap step 37.

get.description: Requires delivery.manage. No-store list of active and inactive Dubai areas; no public selection endpoint. No prototype areas seeded.

200.description: Bounded areas ordered by immutable ID

post.description: Owner configuration with delivery.manage; admin Origin/JSON. Create a client-approved Dubai area. Stable unique code and case-insensitive unique name; no zone fee/delete. Atomic audit and IDs-only event.

409.description: Duplicate code/name or stale version; reload current data

patch.description: Requires delivery.manage and expected version. Replace name/active state; code/emirate/ID immutable. Deactivate rather than delete. No-op preserves metadata; atomic audit/outbox.

409.description: Duplicate code/name or stale version; reload current data

get.description: Requires delivery.manage. One flat Dubai fee/ETA; absent configuration is null/version 0. No defaults; no-store. Unknown query fields rejected.

patch.description: Requires delivery.manage, admin Origin/JSON and expected version. 0 creates, null clears without deleting history. Integer fils; free threshold remains null (disabled). Atomic metadata-only audit/IDs-only event. Changes require quote re-acceptance in later pricing steps.

409.description: Duplicate code/name or stale version; reload current data

get.description: Requires settings.manage. Four typed groups; absent values are null/version 0. No prototype defaults. Private/no-store; no public settings endpoint.

patch.description: Requires settings.manage and expected version. Replace one typed value; 0 creates an absent key, null clears without deleting history. Settings alone do not activate email/WhatsApp delivery. Unknown keys/fields rejected; audit and IDs-only event atomic.

get.description: Requires staff.manage; sanitized keyset pagination by immutable user ID.

patch.description: Requires staff.manage and current version; edit name/email only. Email changes revoke all sessions and durable identity capabilities.

post.description: Requires staff.manage and current version; never deletes users; common Owner lock prevents last active Owner removal. Sessions/reset/issued invitations revoked atomically.

204.description: Deactivated, or already inactive at the supplied current version

409.description: Stale version or last active Owner

post.description: Requires staff.manage and current version. Change a fixed Owner/Staff role; last-active-Owner protected. All sessions and durable capabilities revoked.

409.description: Stale version or last active Owner

post.description: Requires staff.manage and current version. Reactivate an existing account with its saved role/password. Previously revoked capabilities stay revoked; no auto-login.

409.description: Stale version or last active Owner

post.description: Requires staff.manage; approved recipient/name/role stored by the server. Resend revokes the prior pending invitation.

201.description: Invitation issued; secret delivered only by worker email

post.description: Requires staff.manage; idempotent for nonexistent/accepted/revoked invitations.
Single-use 24-hour invitation. Recipient, name and role cannot be supplied by the invitee. Existing accounts are never overwritten/reactivated.

204.description: Account created with the stored role; no auto-login

503.description: Reset configuration or authoritative limiter unavailable
